_what: The slices of old trillion src/lists.json that read-data/list-review.mjs and read-data/list-refusals.mjs read: review, use_heat, the limits they use and the words they refuse with. Kept with the same names so the moved code reads them unchanged.

review._what: Keeping what a list says true (src/list-review.mjs): a list set up for review has an owner, a review state and a date by which it must be checked again on each row (`fields`, by role), and saved views that decide, with the formula engine's rules, which rows need review and why (`views`; a field names a role, `title` is the list's title field). `actions` are what review_list_rows may do to rows: set a state, set the date a review lasts for (expires_days, the list's own or this default), clear it, name who checked or who owns. read_rows_needing_review reads the views and answers each owner the rows they must look at, with the reasons.

use_heat._what: How much a row is used, decaying with time (src/list-review.mjs): use_list_rows adds `add` to a row's heat, which halves every half_life_days; one use keeps a row warm for one half-life (cold_below is half of add); a row is touched at most once every min_gap_minutes (a second use in that time is not written), so heat costs at most one small record per row per gap. read_cold_list_rows lists rows whose heat is below cold_below, a page at a time within scan_rows, leaving out rows whose review is current (a person said they are true).

words.no_list: There is no list {list_id}. list_lists shows the lists this person keeps.
words.bad_review: A review action is one of {actions}: set_up takes expires_days (a number above 0), assign takes owner, the others take row_ids.
words.no_review: {list_id} is not set up for review; set it up first with review_list_rows action set_up.
words.bad_row: Each row is { id?, values: { field_id: value } }; row {index} is not.
